outcome: maternal outcomes (e.g., postpartum hemorrhage, second stage of labor duration, satisfaction with birth)
cohort: A convenience sample of 230 women receiving prenatal care at a nurse-midwifery practice in the US, categorized into waterbirth (n=58), water labor (n=61), or neither (n=111).
finding: Nulliparous women who had a waterbirth experienced a significantly shorter second stage of labor, however, the waterbirth group had a significantly higher incidence of postpartum hemorrhage compared to water labor or no water immersion.
